Definition
[Signed volume]

Source: petersen:page-0026 ↗ def:pet-ch1-riemannian-manifold

If $(V,g)$ is oriented and $e_1,\ldots ,e_n$ is a positively oriented orthonormal basis, define \[ \operatorname {vol}(v_1,\ldots ,v_n) =\det [g(v_i,e_j)] =\det \big([v_1,\ldots ,v_n][e_1,\ldots ,e_n]^T\big). \] In the basis $e_i$, this is $\det [v_1,\ldots ,v_n]$.
